findings.action: R3 still has a check/remove race. After root.Lstat at line 640 verifies the original directory, another actor can rename that directory outside the runtime root and install an empty directory at the same name before root.Remove at line 644. Remove then deletes the replacement, and the outer runtime cleanup can succeed while the original directory remains outside its inventory. The original descriptor was already closed at line 632, so there is no subsequent confirmation that the directory actually emptied was unlinked. The new regression changes the name before Lstat and therefore misses this remaining window. Retain the original descriptor through removal, verify that the original directory was actually unlinked, and add a synchronized regression for replacement after the final identity check.
